_comment: Test courseware for the local-dev stack, created on both sides by
readable_id rules -- get these wrong and the seed fails in confusing ways:
course readable_id must be 'course-v1:ORG+NUMBER' -- exactly ONE '+'.
The run id the seed derives is '<readable_id>+<run_tag>', and mitxonline's
ORG and NUMBER also become the Open edX org/number, so keep them free of
spaces and of the characters Open edX rejects in a course key.
program readable_id must start with 'program' (create_courseware's check).
Dates are deliberately absent: the seed computes them relative to now so a
seeded run is always enrollable (start -7d, enrollment_start -14d, end and
price: null means audit-only -- no Product, so the run cannot be purchased.
finaid: true adds financial-assistance tiers and a request form. On a course
that belongs to a program, prefer setting it on the program instead --
that is where mitxonline expects the request to be made.
